name: Quillix Note
tagline: Handwritten and typed notes on your phone and PC, kept in sync.
description: Quillix Note is a notebook for both typing and writing by hand. Mix text, handwriting, drawings, pictures, PDFs and voice recordings on the same pages, and find any note again with search, folders and tags.
Notes stay on your device. Sign in with Google if you want them on your phone and PC; locked notes are encrypted with your password before they leave the device.
features: Write by hand or type, on lined, grid or blank pages
Mark up PDFs and pictures, and record audio inside a note
Lock notes with a password (AES-256 encryption)
Reminders that ring even when the app is closed
Sync between Android and Windows that never overwrites an edit
Share a note with other people and edit it together
Optional AI help with your own key, off until you add one

collected.data: Your notes, including handwriting, pictures, recordings and attached files (locked notes stay encrypted)
Notes you share and the email addresses of the people you share them with

sent.data: The text, handwriting image or recording for that action
sent.to: The AI or transcription service you set up, with your own key
sent.why: AI and transcription, only when you tap them

dataSafety.deletion: In the app: Settings › Cloud sync › Delete my cloud data. To delete your sign-in account too, email us. Uninstalling removes the notes from that device.
extras: Works without an account. Nothing leaves your device until you sign in.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

releases.notes: Cloud sync works again: sign in once more and your notes sync safely between your devices.
changes: Sign in to Cloud sync again once, with any Google account you choose; your notes upload again by themselves
Just opening a note no longer leaves "conflict copies" on your other devices, and their changes show up within seconds
Note pictures in the list are no longer squashed and update as soon as you close a note
Updates download and install inside the app, and About shows your version, privacy policy and contact
Delete everything you synced from Settings › Cloud sync
Backups from earlier versions can still be restored

releases.notes: First release on Zenith Gen Orbit.
